ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.45:0.55 ratio of high-intensity white/light-gray pixels to low-intensity black/dark-gray pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centrally concentrated dark pigmentation extending into the median notch. Lateral lobes exhibit high-intensity white patches with dark mottling. Left lobe (viewer perspective) shows dense, vertically-oriented dark streaks. Right lobe shows more dispersed dark focal spots within the white field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep U-shaped central depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 85 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge. Notable large concave indentation on the right lobe trailing edge approximately 70 percent from center. Sharp peaks present near both distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical outward sweep with moderate concavity along the trailing edge transitioning to convex curves at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of small, circular white pixel groups located along the trailing edge margin and concentrated near the median notch and distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Visible dark, non-aligned linear pixel disruptions; prominent diagonal rake-like marks on the left lobe ventral surface and horizontal scratches on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the extreme distal tips and along the mid-leading edge. Significant triangular notch on the right lobe trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Protruding bio-fouling (barnacles) creating irregular 3D texture on the fluke tips, altering the expected 2D perimeter.
